chat_path_llm_analytics: assistant_service.answer_question -> analytics_chat_service.try_answer (only when a provider is configured and ANALYTICS_LLM_ENABLED)
analytics_interpreter_service.interpret: LLMService.call_json -> strict Interpretation schema (extra fields rejected)
analytics_chat_service: route = analytics_query | clarification | unsupported | legacy
analytics_query: query_engine.run_query (resolves dates from app.core.clock, matches products within the business, ORM queries filtered by business_id)
query_presenter.facts: deterministic FACT text; analytics_answer_service.explain: LLM interpretation/suggestion kept only if numbers are grounded and no causal claim
response carries path=llm_analytics; failure of any LLM step falls back to the legacy router (path=legacy_router, flagged)
chat_path: LEGACY router path (fallback): frontend chat page -> api.chat() -> POST /api/v1/businesses/{id}/chat
assistant_service.classify_intent(text): keyword rules (no LLM, no date parsing)
per-intent handler queries the business tables via SQLAlchemy / analytics services and builds the answer text (f-strings or LLMService template)

components.determines_date_ranges: nobody parses dates from the question; handlers use fixed trailing windows relative to date.today()
components.constructs_answer: handler f-strings, or LLMService.generate_business_response (template; LLM rephrase only if configured)

llm_in_evaluated_chat_path.scope: LEGACY fixed-intent router only (the fallback path); the LLM analytics path is described under llm_analytics_path

other_llm_paths: goal parsing: POST goals -> goal_service -> LLMService.parse_goal (objective / constraint labels via the model; rule-based fallback)
decision analysis: decision_service -> LLMService.evaluate_agent / generate_strategy_explanation are deterministic templates since 2026-10-13 (no provider call)

llm_facade.swallows_llm_failures: no: OpenAIClient.decide never raises and returns DecisionResult(ok=False, error=<kind>); callers fall back to rules and record the fallback path/reason
llm_facade.temperature: not set (no sampling parameter is sent)
llm_facade.retry: bounded (<= openai_max_retries) for rate-limit / connection errors only; timeouts are never retried
llm_facade.token_accounting: provider-reported usage.input_tokens / output_tokens is kept on DecisionResult.usage

llm_analytics_path.needs: OPENAI_API_KEY configured (OpenAI); without it the legacy router answers and is labelled path=legacy_router

table_asof.question: What were my total sales in January 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: revenue sum, absolute window 1-31 Jan
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)

table_asof.question: How much did I sell in February 2025 in total?
table_asof.required_capability: revenue sum, absolute window 1-28 Feb
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)

table_asof.question: What were my total sales for the three months from January to March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: revenue sum over the whole data span
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/kpi_service.compute_kpis(period_days) — trailing window [today-N, today]; revenue + line count
table_asof.note: kpis(period_days=89) equals Jan 1-Mar 31 only under the evaluation clock 2025-03-31

table_asof.question: How many units did I sell in March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: unit sum, absolute window March
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)

table_asof.question: How many units did I sell in February 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: unit sum, absolute window February
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)

table_asof.question: How did February 2025 sales compare with January? Tell me the percentage change.
table_asof.required_capability: % change between two absolute windows (Feb vs Jan)
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)

table_asof.question: By what percentage did sales change in March 2025 compared with February 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: % change between two absolute windows (Mar vs Feb)
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)
table_asof.note: period_over_period uses equal-length trailing windows, which do not align with calendar months

table_asof.question: Which day had the highest total sales between January and March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: argmax of daily revenue
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/kpi_service.revenue_trend(days) — daily revenue for trailing days (days with sales only)

table_asof.question: Which day had the lowest total sales between January and March 2025, counting only days that have any sales recorded?
table_asof.required_capability: argmin of daily revenue over days with sales
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/kpi_service.revenue_trend(days) — daily revenue for trailing days (days with sales only)

table_asof.question: How did sales from 1 to 15 March 2025 compare with 1 to 15 February 2025, as a percentage change?
table_asof.required_capability: % change between two absolute half-month windows
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)

table_asof.question: Which product sold the most units in February 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: argmax units by product, absolute window Feb
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)
table_asof.note: router -> top_products, but that handler ranks by REVENUE over a fixed trailing 30-day window and ignores the dates/metric in the question

table_asof.question: What were my top 3 products by sales value from January to March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: top-3 products by revenue over the whole data span
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/breakdown_service.top_products(limit) — all-time units+revenue per product, ranked by revenue (GET /analytics/products)
table_asof.note: router -> top_products. Under the evaluation clock the handler answers for March only; under the real clock its 'no sales in the last 30 days' fallback ranks ALL sales by revenue, which coincidentally equals the task because the data span is exactly the asked window

table_asof.question: Which three products sold the most units in March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: top-3 products by UNITS, absolute window March
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)
table_asof.note: router -> top_products, but the handler ranks by revenue, not units

table_asof.question: How many units of BIG ONION did I sell between January and March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: units of one product over the whole data span
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/breakdown_service.top_products(limit) — all-time units+revenue per product, ranked by revenue (GET /analytics/products)
table_asof.note: single call of GET /analytics/products?limit>=2 returns units_sold; equals the asked window because the data span is exactly Jan-Mar

table_asof.question: Which sold more units between January and March 2025, BIG ONION or MILK?
table_asof.required_capability: compare units of two products
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/breakdown_service.top_products(limit) — all-time units+revenue per product, ranked by revenue (GET /analytics/products)

table_asof.question: What share of my total sales came from EGG from January to March 2025? Give a percentage.
table_asof.required_capability: one product's revenue / total revenue
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/breakdown_service.top_products(limit) — all-time units+revenue per product, ranked by revenue (GET /analytics/products)

table_asof.question: Which day of the week brings in the most sales for me?
table_asof.required_capability: weekday with the largest revenue
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/kpi_service.revenue_trend(days) — daily revenue for trailing days (days with sales only)

table_asof.question: Which day of the week is my weakest for sales?
table_asof.required_capability: weekday with the smallest revenue
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/kpi_service.revenue_trend(days) — daily revenue for trailing days (days with sales only)

table_asof.question: How much did I sell on Sundays in total between January and March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: revenue summed over Sundays
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/kpi_service.revenue_trend(days) — daily revenue for trailing days (days with sales only)

table_asof.question: On an average day that I had sales, how much did I sell between January and March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: mean daily revenue over days with sales
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/kpi_service.revenue_trend(days) — daily revenue for trailing days (days with sales only)

table_asof.question: How many different products did I sell in January 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: count of distinct products sold in January
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: services/assistant_service._product_revenue(start,end) — per-product units+revenue for an ABSOLUTE window (internal helper)

table_asof.question: On an average day that I had sales, how many units did I sell in March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: mean DAILY UNITS in March
table_asof.note: no production function returns daily unit totals (revenue_trend returns revenue only)

table_asof.question: What was the highest total sales I made on any single day between January and March 2025?
table_asof.required_capability: largest daily revenue
table_asof.nearest_existing_block: analytics/kpi_service.revenue_trend(days) — daily revenue for trailing days (days with sales only)

table_asof.question: How much of my sales between January and March 2025 came from items with 5% GST?
table_asof.required_capability: revenue by GST slab
table_asof.note: the production sales schema has no GST column

table_asof.question: What percentage of my sales came from items with 18% GST?
table_asof.required_capability: share of revenue by GST slab

table_asof.question: What percentage of my sales came from items with 0% GST?
table_asof.required_capability: share of revenue by GST slab

table_asof.question: Which GST rate brought in the most sales between January and March 2025?

class_definitions.A: answerable through the current production chat path with correct semantics
class_definitions.B1: ONE existing production call, parameters only, returns the quantity (not reachable via chat)
class_definitions.B2: existing building block + trivial arithmetic (sum/count/argmax/mean/%/share/weekday); not reachable via chat
class_definitions.C: no existing building block can supply it (missing field or aggregation)
class_definitions.D: invalid/ambiguous for the dataset (none: the ground-truth engine refuses tie-ambiguous tasks)

data_view.identity: for lines sharing (date, product, unit price p): sum(q_i * p) = p * sum(q_i), so merging by summing quantity conserves revenue; verified numerically above
data_view.label: evaluation-compatible view derived from the approved Indian POS dataset (NOT the original dataset)
